test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Caters** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb "**caters**" is in the present tense, which is appropriate for describing a current action or situation. • **Caters **means to expose or reveal. (उजागर या प्रकट करना) • **Example**: *The recent data breach in a government database caters to the vulnerability of the country's information security systems, highlighting the risks posed by cybercriminals.* Therefore, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Catered **is the past tense form of "cater", meaning to provide food or service for an event or group. (किसी कार्यक्रम या समूह के लिए भोजन या सेवा प्रदान करना) • **Catering **is a noun form of "cater", referring to the act or business of providing food or service for events or groups. (आयोजनों या समूहों के लिए भोजन या सेवा प्रदान करने का कार्य या व्यवसाय) • "**Has catered**" is the present perfect tense form of "cater", indicating an action that started in the past and continues to the present. 14d:T88b, The correct answer is: **Personal**
